title: Individual Sovereignty and Other-Regarding Preferences
abstract: arXiv:2606.25904v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We consider the social aggregation of preferences over lotteries in the presence of other-regarding preferences. If society respects each individual's sovereignty, an axiom we propose akin to Sen's Liberalism, then society's utility is a linear combination of individuals' self-regarding utilities. That is, other-regarding preferences can only influence the weights society places on each individual. We next characterize the unique weighting method under which society's weight ratio between two individuals is the geometric mean of those of all individuals. The central axiom requires that when only a group of individuals is at stake, society's preferences depend only on individuals' preferences towards that group. We extend the first result to a setting with feasibility constraints and to a setting with subjective uncertainty.

translated_title: 个人主权与他人关涉偏好
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在存在他人关涉偏好的情况下，对彩票的偏好进行社会聚合的问题。如果社会尊重每个人的个人主权——这是我们所提出的一个类似于森（Sen）自由主义的公理——那么社会效用就是个体自涉效用的线性组合。也就是说，他人关涉偏好只能影响社会赋予每个个体的权重。接着，我们刻画了一种唯一的加权方法：在该方法下，社会中任意两个个体之间的权重比等于所有个体权重比的几何平均数。其核心公理要求：当只有某一群体涉及利害关系时，社会的偏好仅取决于各个体对该群体的偏好。我们还将第一个结果扩展到了包含可行性约束的情境以及包含主观不确定性的情境。
tldr: 论文证明，若社会遵循类似森自由主义的“个人主权”公理，社会效用必然是个体自涉效用的线性组合，他人关涉偏好只能通过改变个体权重发挥作用，并刻画了权重比等于所有个体权重比几何平均数的唯一加权方法。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that if society respects individual sovereignty—an axiom akin to Sen's Liberalism—social utility must be a linear combination of individuals' self-regarding utilities, so other-regarding preferences can only affect individual weights, and it characterizes the unique weighting method whose pairwise weight ratios equal the geometric mean of all individuals' ratios.
